requirements.requirement: Approved timeline controls source ranges, order and render events
requirements.media: Rendered synthetic Longs and revised MP4 frames and audio
requirements.result: Edited plan is compiled before rendering and immutable revisions are retained.
requirements.limitations: The legacy pause-removal path still applies transcript-derived time compression during scene rendering.

requirements.requirement: Validate bounds, dependencies, asset availability, overlap and transitions
requirements.result: Invalid revision, ranges, event intervals, missing overlays and unsupported operations are rejected.
requirements.limitations: The editor models one primary event per scene and timed secondary overlays.

requirements.requirement: Gameplay Longs use a cross-source narrative planner
requirements.result: Planner applies per-source ranges, contribution limits, category and duration preferences with evidence-backed beats and an explicit shortfall.
requirements.limitations: Three-frame vision evidence is a hypothesis. Missing reaction and consequence remain absent.

requirements.requirement: Render real spatial, timed and temporal effects
requirements.result: Decoded output checks for punch-in, animated zoom, crop, freeze, replay, slow motion, text, image, video and visual accent.
requirements.limitations: Replay and slow motion replace a fixed-duration window in the scene. Overlapping spatial or temporal effects are rejected.

requirements.requirement: Render true visual and audio crossfades
requirements.result: The overlap contains both source colors and both original audio frequencies.
requirements.limitations: Crossfade is available between adjacent Longs scenes with pause removal disabled.

requirements.requirement: Choose optional effects from event evidence
requirements.result: Optional zoom uses a visible payoff and normalized action focus. Explicit removal is respected.
requirements.limitations: Live vision-model accuracy and natural use of automatic effects need human review.

requirements.requirement: Preserve and mix gameplay audio with synchronized effects
requirements.media: Revised synthetic timeline with timed procedural SFX
requirements.result: Original audio, music ducking, narration, silence, gain, fade and procedural SFX use the existing mixer and peak limiter.
requirements.limitations: Music beds use authorized library uploads. Audio source licensing remains the operator's responsibility.

requirements.requirement: Render configurable intro, cold open, outro, chapter titles and branding
requirements.media: long.mp4 synthetic cold-open, intro and outro fixture
requirements.result: Procedural cards visibly change placement and duration. Logo and title overlays are configurable and channel style profiles can be reused.
requirements.limitations: Channel style profiles are saved in the current browser. Cards are available for Longs.

requirements.requirement: Evidence-grounded gameplay hooks and focus-specific ranking
requirements.result: Gameplay scanning uses visible changes without requiring speech. Known, bounded payoffs support distinct hooks and uncertain scenes can omit them.
requirements.limitations: Hook templates cover English and Ukrainian. The specified YouTube reference videos could not be inspected through the available source.

requirements.requirement: Persist independent caption edits without new Whisper inference
requirements.result: In-place text/timing/style edits create a track revision and managed tests prohibit ASR during correction.
requirements.limitations: Manual timing edits clear old word alignments unless matching timed words are supplied.

requirements.requirement: Render a real low-resolution proxy before approval
requirements.media: 640x360 proxy MP4 verified by decoding both picture and sound
requirements.result: The draft timeline reaches REVIEW after proxy generation and reuses retrieved media in final export.
requirements.limitations: Proxy rendering is queued on a local controller worker so the browser can serve it privately.

requirements.requirement: Reuse fingerprinted processing and rendered assets
requirements.result: A second job reuses source metadata, gameplay analysis and rendered scenes; style corrections do not rerun source ASR.
requirements.limitations: Cross-job source analysis reuse requires a stable local file identity. Remote jobs retain per-job checkpoints.

requirements.requirement: At least 30% median wall-time reduction on matched workload
requirements.result: Cold median 15.300 to 14.043 seconds (8.2% faster). Repeated identical jobs 14.189 to 6.013 seconds (57.6% faster).
requirements.limitations: Three runs per condition, x264 on the current host. No general production throughput claim.

requirements.requirement: Reduce avoidable live text evaluation on repeated evidence
requirements.result: With identical accepted selections and the same live Qwen model digest, the repeated stage used 0 requests versus 1 before, eliminating 616 avoidable input and output tokens.
requirements.limitations: The 100% repeat-stage result covers one fixed transcript. End-to-end and vision-model reduction remain unverified.

requirements.requirement: Verify resource scheduling and throughput on the physical RTX 3050 4 GiB
requirements.result: The available GPU reports 6144 MiB. The live text comparison used CPU.
requirements.limitations: A 4096 MiB physical GPU is required for the target acceptance and residency comparison.

requirements.requirement: Record reproducibility and replay the same approved revision
requirements.media: Repeated local output with identical SHA-256
requirements.result: Inputs, hashes where available, timeline revision, accepted hooks, encoder, validation and sampling data are recorded.
requirements.limitations: Current-revision replay is available for local outputs. GPU sampling measures the entire device and local model digests may be unavailable.

requirements.requirement: Live Drive round trip and publishing safety
requirements.result: Mocked upload recovery and idempotent publisher checks are exercised. No real upload was executed.
requirements.limitations: Configured live Drive credentials were unavailable in the verification environment.

requirements.requirement: Run the full regression suite and both POSIX subtitle checks
requirements.result: On Linux, 2307 passed, 66 skipped and zero failed. The dashboard build and Compose configuration also passed.
requirements.limitations: Existing environment-dependent tests retained their skip conditions.

requirements.requirement: Render and inspect real gameplay Shorts and a revised multi-source export
requirements.media: Neverball captures and five validated exports in verification/test-output/f10-real-gameplay
requirements.result: Validated silent, manual-hook and speech-bearing Shorts, a 20-second compilation, a revised export and its 360p proxy.
requirements.limitations: The speech comes from the original synthetic audio fixture. The capture verifies technical behavior and visible timing.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate specified GTA event classes, a full-length Longs export and editorial quality
requirements.result: A timestamped human review rubric is provided.
requirements.limitations: Requires authorized GTA recordings in the desired categories and an independent editorial review.

requirements.requirement: Publish machine-readable and human-readable acceptance evidence
requirements.result: Both formats link verification, limitations and release gates.

requirements.requirement: Continue existing branch and keep the open PR in draft
requirements.result: Milestone commits pushed to codex/factory-10 and tracked in Eclipse-XS/youtube-temka#4.
requirements.limitations: Release remains draft with genuine acceptance gates still open.
